evidence_contract.permanent_invalid_rule: any attempt without a valid completion, any mutation, or any inconsistent chain permanently invalidates the run; the controller has no resume path

schedule.stop: SIGINT or SIGTERM sets a request flag; the current admitted call remains foreground until terminal and is sealed/reopened, then no new attempt or dispatch is made before terminal accounting
